levels.surface: محمد بن الحسن بن أحمد بن الوليد

notes: «قَالَ: حَضَرْتُ مَوْتَ إِسْمَاعِيلَ» : Abu Kahmas speaks in the first person as a witness; he is written as the last link, but the first-person witness account (no name of a teller beyond him) is for ruling.
The Imam Abu Abdullah «جَالِسٌ عِنْدَهُ» and his act (binding the jaw, writing on the shroud) are scene, not a route; the Imam is not written as a link.
